title: Japan Legends with a Temple Stay
alt: Lantern lined path at a temple on Mount Koya, Japan
transport: Bullet trains, a ferry crossing and guided sightseeing

activities.name: Tokyo sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided day through Meiji shrine, the Imperial Palace gardens and the temple lanes of Asakusa.

program.name: Tokyo
program.description: Two nights by Shinagawa station, with a free first evening in Shinjuku and a guided city day after.

activities.name: Kyoto sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided afternoon through Kinkaku-ji, Nijo castle and the shrine gates of Fushimi Inari.

program.name: Kyoto
program.description: The bullet train west, a guided afternoon in the old capital and free time in the Gion lanes.

stops.name: Osaka
stops.subtitle: Osaka by way of Nara
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel at Namba with a rooftop bath

activities.name: Nara sightseeing tour
activities.description: Todai-ji with its great bronze Buddha, the old timber halls of Horyu-ji and the deer that wander the park.

program.name: Osaka

activities.name: Himeji castle

activities.name: Okayama sightseeing tour
activities.description: Korakuen, one of the three great gardens of Japan, and the black keep of Okayama castle beside it.

program.name: Okayama

stops.name: Hiroshima
stops.subtitle: Hiroshima and Miyajima
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel in the city centre

activities.name: Kurashiki canal quarter
activities.description: Free time in the white walled merchant quarter of Kurashiki, where willow trees lean over a stone lined canal.

activities.name: Hiroshima walking tour
activities.description: The peace park, the dome left standing after 1945 and the memorial museum, on foot with a guide.

activities.name: Itsukushima shrine at Miyajima
activities.description: The ferry across to Miyajima and the vermilion gate that stands in the water in front of the shrine.

program.name: Hiroshima
program.description: A full day through Kurashiki, the peace park and the island shrine at Miyajima, with a night in the city.

stops.name: Matsuyama
stops.hotel: ANA Crowne Plaza Matsuyama, an IHG Hotel
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Comfortable hotel in the middle of Matsuyama

activities.name: Matsuyama castle with the cable car
activities.match: Cable Car Ride to Matsuyama Castle
activities.description: A cable car up the hill to one of the twelve original castle keeps left in the country, with the Inland Sea below.

activities.name: Ishite-ji temple
activities.description: One of the eighty eight temples on the Shikoku pilgrimage, with its old gate and pilgrims in white.

activities.name: Dogo Onsen bath house
activities.description: The oldest hot spring in the country, a timber bath house with a wooden tower that inspired the bath in Spirited Away.

program.name: Matsuyama
program.description: Across the Inland Sea to Shikoku for the castle by cable car, a pilgrimage temple and the old Dogo bath house.

activities.name: Kotohira shrine, Ritsurin garden and Uzu no Michi
activities.description: The hillside shrine at Kotohira, the pine garden of Ritsurin and the glass floored walkway over the Naruto whirlpools.

program.name: Kobe
program.description: A night on the harbour pier, reached through Kotohira, Ritsurin garden and the Naruto whirlpools.

stops.name: Mount Koya
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Temple room · 3★ · Working temple lodging on Mount Koya, with its own hot spring bath

activities.name: Kobe earthquake memorial museum
activities.description: The museum built after the 1995 earthquake, which recreates the morning it struck and how the city was rebuilt.

activities.name: Mount Koya sightseeing tour
activities.description: The Okunoin cemetery under its cedars, the Danjo Garan halls and the gate at Daimon, on the mountain where Shingon Buddhism began.

program.name: Mount Koya
program.description: Up the mountain for a night in a working temple, with the Okunoin cemetery and the Danjo Garan halls.

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: The night on Mount Koya in a working temple is the part people talk about afterwards, not the castles.
expert.tip: Set an alarm on the mountain. The monks hold the morning fire ritual just after six and guests are welcome to sit in.

summary: Eleven days down the Inland Sea and across to Shikoku, finishing on a sacred mountain: Tokyo and Kyoto, Nara and Osaka, Himeji castle, Korakuen garden, the Hiroshima peace park and Miyajima, Matsuyama castle with Dogo Onsen, the Naruto whirlpools, and a night in a temple on Mount Koya.
included: Included: 10 nights with daily breakfast, including a night in a temple lodging on Mount Koya; bullet trains and the crossing to Shikoku; private airport transfers; guided sightseeing in Tokyo and in Kyoto; a guided day through Nara; Himeji castle; guided sightseeing in Okayama; Kurashiki, a walking tour of the Hiroshima peace park and the island shrine at Miyajima; Matsuyama castle with the cable car, Ishite-ji and Dogo Onsen; Kotohira, Ritsurin garden and the Naruto walkway; the Kobe earthquake memorial museum; a guided tour of Mount Koya.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
